Welcome to the Nextflow Crash Course — a series of hands-on workshops introducing pipeline development and execution with [Nextflow](https://www.nextflow.io/).

## Day 0: Intro to HPC / Command line (Optional)
Self-paced, to be completed before the workshop. Intended to get participants up to speed on the high-perfomance computing (HPC) environments.

### [Logging onto Hazel HPC](getting_started.html)
How to log on the the NC State HPC Cluster (Hazel)

### [Tour of Hazel / Command line 101](tour_of_hazel.html)

### [Using shared software on Hazel](loading_brc_modules.html)
How to load and run BRC-maintained software modules and containers on Hazel

### [nf-core Pipelines](nf_core_pipelines.html)
Running community-curated nf-core pipelines on Hazel using the BRC's institutional profile
